text:
maria: Heads up — Ops just flagged a degradation hitting embeddings /batch and /embed endpoints in eu-west. Error rate up, latency elevated. Need quick customer-facing copy + when to publish.

sam_ops: seeing 5-10% 5xx, p95 latency spiking. We've queued a rollback for a single infra change. ETA 20–30m for measurable improvement.

maria: thanks. Can we draft a short banner and a full status update? Keep it calm, avoid technical verbs like 'rollback' in banner.

jordan_support: customers already DMing support. Prioritize banner + a ‘we're investigating’ update. Include guidance if they should retry.

alex_product: suggested banner: 

`We’re currently experiencing increased latency for Embeddings in eu-west. We’re investigating — some requests may fail or be slower than usual.`

suggested full status (for status page / email):

```
Incident: Embeddings latency & intermittent errors — eu-west
Current status: Mitigating — Degradation detected at 10:18 UTC. Engineers deployed a targeted rollback; error rates expected to fall within 30 minutes.
Impact: Some customers may see failed or slow embeddings calls in eu-west only. No data loss or security impact.
Recommended action: Automatic retries are recommended; if you see persistent failures, switch to a regional fallback (us-east) where available.
Next update: +30m or when the rollback completes.
```

maria: good. keep it under 280 chars for the banner. Alex copy is fine for the detailed post.

lisa_custsuccess: note for account teams: flag any high-usage customers who've customized embeddings. I'll draft a short DM template: 

`Hi — we’re currently mitigating an embeddings issue in eu-west that may affect inference time. We expect resolution within ~30m. We’ll follow up when things are back to normal. Apologies for the disruption.`

maria: timeline question — when do we publish the initial banner? Immediately? after rollback begins?

sam_ops: publish now as `Investigating`. Switch to `Mitigating` once the rollback is in progress (~5m). Then `Resolved` after 30m if metrics look good.

maria: perfect. I'll post the banner and the status page entry. Who will push the email blast to customers on affected plan tiers?

lisa_custsuccess: I'll handle targeted emails for high-touch customers after we see improvements (aim +40m). For mass comms, marketing — do we want a short note to newsletter subscribers?

maria: hold mass comms — only targeted DMs/emails for impacted customers now. We should avoid alarming broad lists.

statusbot: [automated] Banner posted to status page: `Investigating — We’re looking into increased latency for Embeddings (eu-west)`.

jordan_support: pinging Support triage to add a canned reply using Lisa's DM template.

maria: actionable checklist for the next 60m:
- publish banner now (Investigating) ✅
- update status page with Alex's full copy when rollback is confirmed (Mitigating) ⏳
- CS targeted DMs at +30–45m after improvement ✅ (Lisa)
- mass newsletter: HOLD ⛔
- postmortem owners: Ops + Product (Alex + Sam) — marketing to help with customer-facing summary after RCA

maria: any objections?

sam_ops: none. will update when rollback starts.

maria: thanks team — I’ll post the banner and queue the status page draft. Will update thread when we switch to Mitigating. :thumbsup:
